description: RustDesk is a full-featured open source remote control alternative for self-hosting and security with minimal configuration. You have full control of your data, with no concerns about security.
tagline: RustDesk is a full-featured open source remote control alternative for self-hosting and security with minimal configuration. You have full control of your data, with no concerns about security.
author: WisdomSky

tips.before_install:
RustDesk clients connect to this server using your CasaOS host IP and port `21116`.

The container image includes a shell, so the CasaOS terminal can be used normally.
